info.bio: Material Issue was a power pop power trio from Chicago, Illinois. Their trademark was a brand of dense, rich, manic, and powerful pop tunes. Their lyrics revolved heavily around themes of love and heartbreak, having a phalanx of girl's-first-name-titled songs. Singles such as "Diane" and "Valerie Loves Me" remain staples of rock radio. Formed in 1985, Material Issue was the brainchild of frontman Jim Ellison (who also played guitar, provided lead vocals, and wrote all Material Issue songs).

scenes.name: Renacimiento pop, Elephant 6 y lounge-pop
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: En la primera mitad de los noventa el pop supera ampliamente a la música experimental: la revancha de la melodía tras un cuarto de siglo de sonidos progresivos. La vía más rentable sigue el pop barroco de los últimos Beach Boys, Van Dyke Parks, Big Star y XTC: Jellyfish (Bellybutton), Imperial Teen, Velvet Crush, Material Issue, Eggs, Fountains Of Wayne, Ben Folds Five, Chainsaw Kittens, Barenaked Ladies. El colectivo «Elephant 6» de Georgia y Luisiana es la escuela pop más influyente de la década: Apples In Stereo, Olivia Tremor Control, Neutral Milk Hotel (In The Aeroplane Over The Sea), Elf Power, Of Montreal; y sus herederos Ladybug Transistor y Photon Band. El folk-pop a lo Tom Petty y R.E.M.; el «lounge-pop» (Combustible Edison, Zumpano, Ivy, Cardigans, Squirrel Nut Zippers); el teen-pop (Hanson, Britney Spears, Backstreet Boys).

podcast.title: 90s Alt-Rock Discovery
podcast.body: Material Issue is named as one of the 1990s bands that mid-40s individuals, who grew up with grunge, might now explore as "new to them" music. This indicates a pool of overlooked acts from their formative years.

podcast.title: Tragic End of Singer
podcast.body: Material Issue's career was "derailed by the sudden suicide of singer Jim Ellison." Despite this tragedy, their spirit continues, notably through an annual Powerpop festival in Chicago named "International Pop Over Throw," inspired by their album title. "I love these guys, but they were derailed by the sudden suicide of singer Jim Ellison."

xref.title: Suicide and Legacy
xref.body: Jim Ellison, the singer for Material Issue, tragically committed suicide, which derailed the band's career. His life and music left a lasting impact, inspiring The Tragically Hip's song "Escape is at Hand for the Traveling Man" and being honored by the annual "International Pop Over Throw" festival in Chicago. "However, their spirit lives on. Chicago, host an annual festival called International Pop Over Throw that's been going on since 1997, and it features bands in the whole PowerPop vein."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
